reason: I have a cousin back home who handles these things and I know the whole chain. A brand-new company asking me to trust it with lakhs is a harder sell, and I'm not convinced it saves me the bank hassle.
objection: My Indian bank will still call me or ask me to come in. Nothing here says they won't, so what am I actually paying CAD $199 to avoid?
would_change_my_mind: A friend in one of my WhatsApp groups telling me they did a transfer of around 10 lakh with this company, with the bank never asking them to visit. Or the company saying in writing that it deals with my bank for me.
